import unreal
lib=unreal.EditorAssetLibrary
m=lib.load_asset('/Game/P4/Meshy/SK_P4_Meshy')
c=unreal.SkeletalMeshComponent(); c.set_skeletal_mesh_asset(m)
for b in ('Armature','pelvis','spine_01','thigh_l','hand_r'):
    i=c.get_bone_index(b) if hasattr(c,'get_bone_index') else -1
    t=c.get_bone_transform(b, unreal.BoneSpaces.LOCAL_SPACE) if hasattr(c,'get_bone_transform') else None
    print('A28 bonescale', b, i, t.translation if t else None, t.scale3d if t else None)
rp=m.get_editor_property('ref_skeleton') if False else None
try:
    import unreal
    sk=m.skeleton
    print('A28 bonescale skel', sk.get_path_name())
except Exception as e: print('A28 bonescale err', e)
